messages:
maria: quick a11y pass on the Model Activity heatmap/timeline in the Insights panel. Keyboard scrubbing and color contrast are the main issues noticed in QA.
jules: thanks  can you share repro steps or a short video clip?
maria: repro: open Insights -> Activity tab -> focus the timeline heatmap. Try to move through time bins with left/right arrows. Two problems: 1) focus skips cells (tab lands on the whole widget, arrows don't move focus unless you first click), 2) screen reader reads a giant numeric dump for every bin when arrowing fast (super noisy).
raja: ok felonies. We treat the heatmap as a composite widget visually, but semantically it's unclear. Is it a grid/list/slider? That affects keyboard behavior.
sam: current implementation renders each cell as a `div` in a grid with no tabindex, and we rely on pointer events. We should implement roving tabindex or a single slider-type control depending on expected interaction (scrub vs choose single bin).
a11y-bot: suggested checklist: 1) decide semantics: either role="grid" + roving tabindex per cell (arrow keys navigate with aria-colindex/aria-rowindex) OR role="slider" when scrubbing through a timeline; 2) visible focus indicator on focused cell (2px high-contrast outline + inner shadow); 3) colorblind-safe palette tokens and texture fallback for high-density cells; 4) avoid verbose sr output during rapid scrubbing (debounce announcements, announce on commit); 5) provide aria-valuetext summarizing bin (time range + value) and aria-roledescription="heatmap"/"timeline"; 6) ensure each cell meets minimum contrast for its glyph/text or provide non-color cues.
maria: i vote grid semantics with roving tabindex if users need to inspect discrete bins; slider semantics if the intent is scrub/preview. Current product goal is "inspect counts at a point" so grid+roving seems right.
jules: grid works. For SR: each cell should have `role="gridcell" aria-colindex/aria-rowindex aria-posinset aria-setsize aria-label="Apr 10, 12:00 30 calls" aria-roledescription="time bin"`. Keep the label short but informative.
raja: on verbosity: implement a 200ms debounced announce for arrow navigation. If user pauses, read the aria-label. If they hold arrow and scrub quickly, only update a small live region with brief value (or mute until release). Also provide a keyboard shortcut to toggle verbose announcements for power users.
sam: focus outline  current styles remove outline: none on `.heatmap-cell:focus`. We'll restore `outline` or use `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ink)` plus `border: 2px solid var(--focus-ink-contrast)`. Also ensure the focused cell has a visible text fallback (like a dot or pattern) for low-contrast cells.
a11y-bot: color/token notes: avoid pure hue-only encodings. Use `--heat-0` .. `--heat-5` paired with `--heat-0-pattern` SVG background for colorblind modes. For light/dim themes, ensure foreground glyph/text on cells meets 4.5:1 against cell background or overlay a high-contrast stroke.
maria: tests: add unit for keyboard (roving tabindex works), integration e2e that simulates fast arrow holds and asserts debounced live announcements, axe scan for contrast, and manual VoiceOver/TalkBack pass where QE tries: mouse explore, arrow scrub, hold arrow (fast), shift+arrow to range-select, and quick commit with Enter.
qe-bot: flagged flaky: "heatmap keyboard navigation" test in CI sometimes fails on virtualization. Add a wait for rendering to stabilize rather than brittle timeouts. Also add a screenshot diff for colorblind palette switch.
jules: small copy/UX: when a cell is focused, the tooltip shows exact range and count. For SR we should keep the tooltip content mirrored in the aria-label, but don't announce both tooltip+live region to avoid duplicate speech.
raja: implementation plan: 1) switch heatmap to `role=grid` + gridcell semantics + roving tabindex; 2) add debounced aria-live (role=status) for announcements and only announce on pause/commit; 3) restore visible focus styles and add pattern overlays for colorblind mode; 4) update color tokens and include contrast screenshots in PR; 5) tests: unit keyboard, e2e debounced announce, axe CI, manual SR smoke.
sam: i'll prototype the roving-keyboard behaviour and pattern overlays. Will post a short gif and the color contrast table.
a11y-bot: follow-up tasks: run VoiceOver/TalkBack smoke after merge, verify NVDA readout on Windows, and include a short accessibility note in the release doc.
maria: thanks team  this one's subtle but will make the timeline discoverable and usable for keyboard & SR users. happy to review the PR. :thumbsup:
